text:
maya: Heads-up — enterprises onboarding with strict retention asked for a concrete ingest + evidence packaging flow for audit logs + customer-owned keys. Can we sync assumptions? (cc @jack @sam)

jack: +1. High level: 1) ingest logs 2) tag tenant 3) store with envelope encryption 4) export bundles on demand. Need gap vs current platform.

sam: Current infra: audit logs streamed to s3, 90d retention, no per-tenant key separation. Dedicated has KMS integration but handshake is manual.

elena: For SOC2 customers we need chain-of-custody metadata, tamper-evident digests, and retention policy enforcement. Also legal-hold ability.

maya: Proposed MVP scope: per-tenant buckets with envelope encryption using customer-supplied key reference (not raw key), audit manifest with SHA256 per file, on-demand evidence export tool (zip + signed manifest). Keep default retention 90d, enterprise can set 1y/3y/indef.

sam: Ops concerns: per-tenant buckets means far more S3 resources and IAM policies. Suggest virtual namespaces + object metadata tagging and KMS key id field. Also need a rotation story.

jack: Can we support BYO-KMS where customer supplies key ARN and we use our service to envelope-encode with that KMS? Need to check cross-account key grants.

elena: Legal-hold: we must suspend deletion across retention layers. Need retention flag in metadata and a removal workflow requiring legal team sign-off.

ops-bot: infra-deploy triggered by @sam: https://ci.redwood/1234 — plan: create per-tenant namespace feature branch. :rocket:

maya: Launch criteria (what product wants): 1) Evidence export proves chain-of-custody for 3 sample tenants 2) KMS escrow handshake documented 3) Retention enforcement automated and testable 4) Runbook for legal-hold + TTL overrides.

jack: Ask to PM: Which customers are pilots? We should invite 2 customers with differing requirements (one wants 1y, one indefinite). Also allocate eng-sre time for key-grant automation.

maya: Pilot candidates: @stripe-eng (simulated), @finOS (internal), also @customer-success to coordinate. I'll put together a one-pager and acceptance checklist.

elena: Quick note on ISO: evidence packaging must include access logs, config snapshots, and a signed manifest. Add that to checklist.

sam: Implementation note snippet:
```
PUT /v1/tenants/{id}/keys
body: { "key_ref": "arn:aws:kms:...", "purpose": "audit-encrypt" }
```
We validate via VerifyGrant lambda.

maya: OK let's sync tomorrow 10am. Action items: maya -> one-pager, sam -> infra cost estimate, jack -> key-grant research, elena -> legal-hold runbook draft. :handshake:

jack: :thumbsup:

end of thread.
